generations.note: Same paired seeds and node budgets for before/after. Different node budgets versus opponent; no universal zero-loss guarantee.

depth.selection: Five targeted phases, not a win-rate test

value_head.baseline: frozen Garry 2.0.0 WASM; identical policy weights
value_head.note: Measured reduction of defeats on one fixed-node sample; no claim of statistically established superiority or universal invincibility. Raw-head and extended-data trials are retained separately.

source_metrics.target: depth-9 bounded search centipoints, non-mate positions
source_metrics.split: whole game trajectories; validation not used for fitting or hyperparameters
